resolutions.asset: Elementary integer checks and independent Eratosthenes basis
Canonical tool coverage for this task
resolutions.boundary: Coverage lookup is not itself tool use; actual executions above supply use. No general-purpose new mechanism is being introduced.

brc.carrier: Coverage-labeled internal gap events plus ordered first/last prime ports, counts, maxima and source hashes.
brc.combination: Union of within-block events together with explicit serial last-to-first bridge events, before threshold projection.
brc.observer: Only the frozen >=916 gap-start catalogue and accepted q78553 shadow map; all future smaller-gap or arbitrary prime-array queries are outside this retained observer.
brc.provenance_loss_boundary: Counts and first occurrences alone lose positions. Array digests authenticate a replay but do not store the arrays. Completeness relies on the recorded complete generation and code invariant, checked by count references and bounded independent replications.
brc.mathematical_scope: Finite positive integer data; no signed mass, recurrent or asymptotic conclusion.
